Hi Jared / Priya —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned for the POC: 

1) Goal / success criteria (from today)
- Serve production-like queries to validate latency and unit cost at 95th percentile under a sample workload (Target: <200ms p50, <400ms p95 for 1k concurrent users).
- Validate quality on a representative prompt set (we agreed on ~200 prompts; baseline quality pass rate >= 92%).
- Verify integration pieces: SSO sign-on and API-based inference from your staging VPC.

2) Scope & timeline
- Access provisioning and credentials: Redwood to provide API key + SSO invite + IP allowlist instructions by Thu 16 Jul. (Owner: Marissa / Ethan)
- Baseline evaluation plan: Acme to run 200-prompt eval and share results within 10 business days of access. (Owner: Priya / Acme eng)
- Checkpoint demo + results review: week of Jul 27.

3) Owners
- Redwood: Marissa (project lead), Ethan (SE - infra & API support), Lauren (CS - enablement & success criteria tracking)
- Acme: Priya (PM), Jared (Engineering lead), Acme IT (network/IP allowlist)

4) Immediate asks for Acme:
- Please confirm the IP ranges you want us to add to the allowlist (or confirm you prefer SSO-only).
- Confirm list of users to invite via SSO (emails) for the POC.

Attachments: acme-poc-kickoff-plan.pdf (high-level evaluation plan + prompt set outline) attached.

If that looks good I will get the SSO invites and API provisioning started and loop Ethan in for the allowlist/IP stuff.

Best,
